name: Hot Ones: Extra Heat
summary: Hot Ones: Extra Heat challenges celebrity guests to answer spicy questions while eating even spicier wings.

name: The Drop: A Snowfall Saga
summary: The Drop follows Wanda and Leon (from the original Snowfall series), who are now fighting to reinvent themselves in '90s Los Angeles, where the fallout from the crack epidemic is fueling a new game: the rise of West Coast rap.

name: Огни большого города
summary: After her father's death, Lika Lunina's quiet life changes overnight. She discovers that her parents are not her biological ones. Leaving home, Lika sets out to find her real parents, who lost her during the turbulent days of the 1991 coup. The task seems impossible, but love will help her unravel the mystery…

name: HaMithazim
summary: investigative program presented by Chaim Etgar, which exposes a long line of serial imposters, all of whom have one thing in common: they have tricked a large number of victims. Each episode will feature a chase after a different imposter.

name: Polen
summary: The Luján Zamudio family appears perfect until a tragedy reveals that nothing is as it seems. On the night of Beatriz's birthday, the matriarch behind the Prestigio Hotel and Mexico's largest floral empire, the celebration ends in horror when her body falls from her room. What initially appears to be a suicide soon uncovers an even more disturbing truth: Beatriz was poisoned with pollen, a lethal substance. Jacobo, her favorite son, returns after years away, determined to uncover the truth. Meanwhile, prosecutor Sandra Fitzgerald faces a family where everyone is hiding something: ambitious children, resentful ex-husbands, and dangerous partners. Amid poisonous flowers, unexpected alliances, forbidden romances, and long-buried secrets, no one is safe.

name: The World Is Dancing
summary: In 1374, amid the turmoil of the Northern and Southern Courts' long running conflict, a boy named Oniyasha is born into a family of sarugaku theater performers. He spends his days in a kind of quiet gloom, haunted by a simple but persistent question: Why do people dance? Then, one day, he witnesses a dance that he feels to be "good"—and everything begins to change. This is the story of the beautiful young boy who would one day shape the art of Noh and be remembered as Zeami.

name: Sin and Love
summary: Police, drug lords, undercover agents, and spies—all layers of the power system are collapsing. Behind a seemingly lawful police hierarchy lies a city controlled by corruption, desire, and hidden power games, where human lives are only bargaining chips. A mysterious kidnapping exposes a buried network of crimes, unraveling misaligned identities, systemic corruption, and a long-suppressed past. Love and sex become tools of control and exchange. And the real chaos began ten years ago, within a forgotten relationship that never truly ended.

name: Sofia the First: Magical Friends
summary: Welcome to the Charmswell School for Royal Magic! Spend time with Sofia and her Royal Friends, where she takes you on a sparkling tour of her brand-new royal school, where every castle shines with its own special kind of magic. Along the way, she'll introduce you to her old and new friends — Pepper, Clover, Layla, Zane, and Camila — each with amazing talents and magical gifts of their own. With Sofia as your guide, there's no better way to discover the magic of Charmswell!

previousepisode.name: Make A Rainbow Potion with Sofia and Camila

name: Troppo Invidiosa
summary: Vicky's on the verge of turning 40, and she can't help envying those who seem to have everything she once dreamed of. But an unexpected turn in her life will send her on a wildly chaotic journey filled with new romance, revelations from the past, and surprising encounters.

name: My Bias, My Boss
summary:
For thirteen years, Nam Da Reum has been a dedicated fan of idol star Lee Chan. When she lands a job at fashion company APPELLO, she's shocked to find out that her beloved idol co-founded the company. Da Reum resolves to hide her identity as a fan and prove that she can be a professional. However, when she starts work, she's faced instead with workaholic CEO Kang Ha Gi, Chan's childhood friend. Meanwhile, Ha Gi seems to harbor hidden, unrequited feelings for Chan, and Chan struggles to maintain his public persona while dealing with a complicated personal life. As the three become entangled, Da Reum finds herself caught between her past obsession with Chan and a growing, unexpected connection with Ha Gi. 


.

name: Pulitzer Prize Playhouse
summary: Pulitzer Prize Playhouse is a classic 1950–1952 dramatic anthology series that featured weekly adaptations of Pulitzer Prize-winning plays, novels, and stories. Hosted and narrated by journalist Elmer Davis, the television program brought prestigious literary and theatrical works to the growing American medium.

name: JAŸ-Z IN 8
summary: 30 years after his landmark debut album "Reasonable Doubt," artist, icon, philanthropist, entrepreneur JAŸ-Z sits down with longtime friend, producer, and director Rick Rubin for an intimate reflection on his storied career, revisiting the music together and unpacking his work and life through a shared listening and illuminating conversation. Featuring many of JAŸ-Z's iconic tracks and album cuts, including "99 Problems," "Brooklyn's Finest," and "4:44," the eight-episode series offers a deeply revealing portrait of the artist and his work, exploring the influences and inspiration that shaped both the man and his music.

name: Locker Diaries: Phineas and Ferb
summary: Class is back in session for Phineas and Ferb! But that doesn't mean the fun has to end. From inside school lockers, we follow everyone's favorite brothers on new adventures.

name: The Wolf King
summary: The Wolf King follows princess Aurora, after being abducted by a brooding werewolf alpha from a world that treated her as a decorative pawn, uncovering her own wild strength. Ensnared in a lethal love triangle, she is thrust into a bloodthirsty war between humankind and her feral captors, forcing her to decide whether she's a prize to be claimed or the master of her own destiny.

name: Aquamarine
summary: When teenaged Coral moves to a dreamy seaside town, she begins unraveling the truth behind her mother's disappearance—and discovers her mother was a mermaid, awakening magical powers in Coral just as secrets beneath the waves threaten to surface.

name: Declaration
summary: The story of immigrants from Ulster who played a critical role in America's break from Britain.

name: Terror on the Space Station
summary:
Terror on the Space Station is a gripping exploration of life aboard the most dangerous construction site in human history. Hurtling around Earth at 17,000mph, the International Space Station is protected only by thin metal walls, shielding astronauts from the most hostile environment humans have ever endured.

In this high-stakes documentary, international astronauts, along with mission controllers, recount the ISS's most terrifying moments - from toxic gas leaks and meteor strikes to spacewalk crises, faulty spacesuits, docking disasters, rogue satellites, and the heart-stopping incident when the entire station spun wildly out of control. These are stories of survival, split-second decisions, and the brilliance that kept them alive 250 miles above Earth.

name: Mighty Truckers
summary: Being a truck driver isn't easy - long hours, huge loads and busy roads are just some of the issues. Truckers from Germany, Italy and Holland share their journeys.

name: Универ. 17 лет спустя
summary:
Varya and Michael finally move into their own house and are ready for a happy life, but everything changes after the tragic incident with Varya's patient, after which she ends up in a sect. Anton and Marina decide to have a baby and go through a difficult IVF path, which forces Anton to completely change his usual lifestyle.

 Valya and Masha face a new challenge after an accident: Valya loses his eyesight, and the family has to learn to live in new circumstances. Kristina, after failures in her personal life, decides to focus on her son and business, but unexpectedly meets two men at once who return her feeling of care and support. And Alla and Kuzi begin a new stage of family life: after the birth of their son Makar, they have to re-assign roles in the family, which leads to conflicts and a struggle for business.

name: Twist of Fate
summary: SS-Lieutenant Colonel Helmut Von Schreader conceives an unusual plan to escape the aftermath of the Second World War by disguising himself as a Jewish Concentration Camp victim. Under the alias of Ben Grossman, Von Schreader is liberated from the camps and immigrates to Palestine where he joins the Zionist movement.

name: Re: The End of the Tiny World: Half A Year Later
summary: Six months after the deadly events of The Master Plan, underworld negotiator Kida drifts through life until he is reluctantly drawn into a new case to save a childhood friend. His mission connects him with a mysterious woman, Michiru, whose favorite phrase hints at a deeper connection to Kida's past.

name: Drag Race México: Latina Royale
summary: Drag Race México: Latina Royale brings together 11 queens from across Latin America for a glamorous battle for the crown, with Mexico as the season's proud host. Led by Taiga Brava and Lolita Banana, the competition serves up talent, fashion, comedy, music, and delicious telenovela-style rivalry across 10 episodes packed with flavor, spectacle, and drama.

name: Ash
summary: Undercover officer Mo Feihuan unexpectedly crosses paths with Xu Luetao, the CEO of Tianping Group. Drawn together by fate, both men hide behind carefully crafted masks and dangerous secrets. As their true identities are gradually revealed, sweetness turns into suspicion, and even the deepest devotion seems destined to fail. A single careless remark from Xu Luetao shatters their fragile bond. Meanwhile, a major cross-border counterfeit operation exposes a brutal power struggle among local forces, drawing both the underworld and the police into a deadly game. Caught in the eye of the storm, Mo Feihuan and Xu Luetao find that the only person they can truly trust is each other. With every step leading deeper into danger and every moment apart deepening their longing, they stand together against overwhelming odds. Though divided by opposing worlds, their hearts remain destined for the same path.

name: Wong Fei-hung: Curse of the Voodoo Spirits
Summer Serendipity
summary: Su Wan, a university student majoring in animal psychology, has loved animals since childhood and cannot bear to see them harmed. One day, she learns that a group of dogs has been trafficked by a criminal gang. Determined to save them, she follows a trail of clues alone to the gang's hideout, despite the risks to her own safety. Outnumbered and quickly discovered, Su Wan finds herself in grave danger as the criminals close in. Just when all hope seems lost, a familiar yet unfamiliar figure appears and subdues the gang, rescuing her. To Su Wan's astonishment, the mysterious young man is Ye Tianyu—her childhood companion who has been separated from her for sixteen years. Once inseparable, the two were torn apart by unexpected circumstances. Their dramatic reunion rekindles a long-lost connection and brings their lives together once again.

name: The Forbidden Land
summary: Spring at Qiongzhou University is shattered when Li Weihao, a design student, leaps to his death. Rejected by the girl he loved, tormented by relentless campus bullying, betrayed by his parents, and stripped of his dreams, he chooses to end his life. His death becomes a mirror, exposing the darkest secrets hidden within everyone around him. His childhood friend Zhang Chao is forced to confront long-buried trauma, triggering the emergence of a ten-year-old alternate personality within him. Psychologist Chen Rong, haunted by guilt over failing to respond to Li Weihao's desperate plea for help in time, joins the investigation. Bai Qiu, the girl Li secretly loved, risks infiltrating influencer Zhu Xiaoyu's illegal trafficking network to uncover the truth behind her best friend Shasha's suspicious car crash. Meanwhile, former bully Lin Jiaming struggles under the oppressive control of his authoritarian father, Lin Yongtai. As the investigation unfolds, a web of campus bullying, corruption, sexual exploitation, and drug-facilitated assaults is gradually brought to light, all leading to the vast criminal empire secretly orchestrated by billionaire Lin Yongtai.

name: Amor Secreto
summary: Irene is the perfect secretary—a dream come true for any executive: intelligent, efficient, and absolutely reliable. Yet, despite her impressive skills, she is an introverted young woman with low self-esteem, leading her to believe she holds no romantic appeal for men. This personal insecurity has driven her to focus intensely on her work, fueled by a strong desire for professional success. Over time—and almost without realizing it—Irene falls in love with her boss, Leonardo Ferrandiz, a millionaire widower raising five children on his own; he is far too busy to notice his secretary's feelings. Irene's secret love and deep sense of responsibility compel her to go to great lengths and endure significant challenges to ensure Leonardo's happiness—such as acting as a surrogate mother to his children and resolving countless issues, not only at the office but also within the Ferrandiz household. Through her loyalty and dedication, Irene gradually earns her boss's admiration, as well as the respect and affection of his children. In the process, these experiences help transform her into a different woman—more confident and assertive—capable of winning Leonardo's love.

name: Alice's Adventures on Earth
summary: Travel host, stunt woman and sustainability expert Alice Ford explores some of our world's most awe-inspiring natural wonders; national parks, forests, mountain ranges, beaches and deserts. Find the adventure in nature, around the world and in our own backyard.

previousepisode.name: Great Basin National Park: Ancient Bristlecones + America's Darkest Skies

name: Pen Tor
summary: Pentor is a sit-com about modern working singles who are looking for their soul mates. It is centered on the busy life of Mr. Pentor, who is a businessman in the BKL company. He wants to have an easy life and just wants to be a normal businessman like other people in Bangkok. However, what he wants is never what he gets.

name: First Cry
summary:
A declining birthrate, shortage of doctors, and a wave of maternity ward closures in rural areas. In modern Japan, the front lines of childbirth—the very place meant to protect mothers and babies—are facing an unprecedented crisis. Even perinatal medical centers, responsible for handling high-risk pregnancies, are reaching their limits in accepting emergency cases. 

Amid this harsh reality, a secret team is formed under the direct orders of the hospital director at one of Japan's most prestigious, high-end hospitals in Tokyo. They are known as "Maternal and Neonatal Emergency Medical Unit." Their mission is to save pregnant women with complex circumstances who have nowhere else to go—completely free of charge. 

The key member of this team is Aki Mitsui, a highly skilled obstetrician-gynecologist. Despite partial hearing loss in one ear, she is a self-made specialist who is more obsessed with hearing a baby's first cry than anyone else. Can Aki and her team become the last line of defense, saving lives hanging in the balance? 

Set behind the scenes of a glamorous celebrity hospital, this medical entertainment drama depicts the fierce struggles of the elite unit as they fight to protect new life!

name: Yagami Eiko: Ueno Chuo Police Station Organized Crime Countermeasures Division
summary: Set in the culturally diverse Ueno district of Tokyo, the story follows Eiko Yagami, a beautiful and dangerous detective in the Organized Crime Countermeasures Division (colloquially known as "Marubo"). Breaking all the rules, Yagami doesn't hesitate to use violence or ally with the Yakuza and the Chinese mafia. Her ultimate, driving goal is to uncover the truth behind the murder of her husband—a freelance journalist who dug too deep into the criminal underworld.

name: Mousetrap
summary: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

name: Hanzaisha
summary: Following the sole survivor of a random mass stabbing who is given a mysterious 10-day ultimatum to live, three unlikely allies—a determined detective, an investigative reporter, and the targeted survivor—risk everything to unravel the truth behind a shocking conspiracy hiding in the dark heart of Japanese society.

name: Last Note
summary: A love story between Ichinose Aoi, a 49 year old woman who has experienced all kinds of ups and downs in life, such as marriage, divorce, failures, and Higuchi Subaru, a 30 year old man who gave up on his dreams due o his upbringing and has been living without his emotions. One day, Aoi meets Subaru due to a problem involving her best friend. Despite the difference in age and background, the two gradually come to understand each other and find themselves drawn towards each other.

name: My Fiction
summary: My Fiction follows Masaki Igawa, an ordinary caregiver who slips into a coma after an accident. When he wakes up a week later, he returns home to find an imposter living his life—and his colleagues, neighbors, and even his wife, Mayumi, have entirely forgotten him.

name: A Livid Lady's Guide to Getting Even: How I Crushed My Homeland with My Mighty Grimoires
summary: Elizabeth Leiston, the daughter of Haldoria's powerful prime minister, is the picture of a refined noble lady and the perfect future queen. But when her fiancé publicly humiliates her, calls off their engagement, and starts spreading nasty rumors about her, Elizabeth reaches her breaking point. Why should her only friend be her loyal maid, and why should she continue to serve a country that doesn't respect her? Elizabeth concludes she won't stand it any longer and will bring down the kingdom, even if it's the last thing she does! As such, she uses her quick wit and, more importantly, her seven magic grimoires to embark on a quest for revenge. And let her tell you, there will be hell to pay!

previousepisode.name: A Livid Lady's Revenge Never Ends

name: Вторжение
summary: On June 22, 1941, the life of every Soviet citizen was split into "before" and "after." How did the world plunge into the abyss of the Second World War? Why did the West allow fascism to triumph? What did the Soviet Union do to prevent the war? You will find the answers in the documentary series *Invasion*.

name: Last Resort
summary:
The series finds retired librarian Gail, her sister Joy who suffers from early-stage dementia, and old friends Dee and Charlie setting off for a fun filled holiday meant to be Joy's bucket list trip. But when tragedy strikes in the idyllic holiday town, the police are quick to call it an accident. However, the group are convinced it is murder and set out to prove it.   

The friends dive into their own investigation with the help of Joy's daughter Kate soon crossing paths with DI Simon Lund. As old crimes surface and dark patterns emerge, the group of friends finds that this seemingly idyllic resort town – with its beach walks, pub lunches, and good-natured bickering - hides something far more sinister. Together they must piece together one devastating mystery and track down a killer who has been hunting in this close–knit coastal community and beyond.

name: Life in the Animal Kingdom
summary:
Experience the breathtaking diversity, resilience, and vibrant colors of the animal kingdom. From majestic lions and soaring peregrines to mysterious manta rays and gentle manatees, explore a world brimming with extraordinary species.

Life in the Animal Kingdom unveils the interconnected wonders of nature, showcasing the beauty and ingenuity of its inhabitants. Embark on a captivating journey into their lives and uncover the secrets that make our natural world so remarkable.

name: You Deserve to Know
summary: You Deserve to Know follows three suburban couples — next-door neighbors and best friends. When one of their husbands is murdered, a shocking trail of secrets is revealed, and their friendship cracks wide open.

name: False Memory
summary: When the world around you isn't what it seems, you may be in the midst of a Bug Man; powerful being who can warp the very nature of one's memories. The Memory Collectors are here to bring order... whether we like it or not.

name: Seat Change Love
summary: Mayama, an ordinary student, receives a love letter from the boy sitting behind him. It turns out to be from Asamiya, the most popular and handsome boy in the class.

name: The Ratties
summary: The Ratties is a British animated series following a chaotic family of six rats who live behind the skirting board of a country house. Full of dubious initiative, the rats hilariously try to emulate the activities of their human hosts, but their illogical minds consistently produce funny and disastrously different results.

name: El Renacer de Luna
summary:
The lives of Luna Arteaga and Maya become intertwined in a story of secrets, betrayal, and second chances. Luna, a young music student in Los Angeles, returns to Mexico when her father's illness and a crisis at the family estate force her to confront a past built on lies. Unbeknownst to her, the source of the turmoil is Dalila Mondragón, the woman she has always believed to be her mother.

Meanwhile, Maya is determined to rebuild her life after escaping an abusive marriage. With the support of Sebastián, a doctor who restores her hope, she begins to dream of a new future. But threats from her ex-husband and long-buried secrets threaten to destroy her happiness.

When a devastating truth comes to light, both women will find themselves caught in a battle over identity, love, and a disputed inheritance that will change their lives forever.

name: Guardián de Mi Vida
summary:
Sofía Peralta-Avitia runs her family's powerful business empire while trapped in an unhappymarriage to Gonzalo Balmori-Ricci, a serial cheater obsessed with a much younger woman namedGrecia. Her life takes an unexpected turn when Franco Gallardo, a humble man from thecountryside, becomes her bodyguard. What begins as a professional relationship soon blossomsinto a love strong enough to challenge Gonzalo's ambition, jealousy, and desire for control.Meanwhile, Sofía's daughter, Bárbara "Barbi," finds love with her new bodyguard, Salvador "Chava"Reyes, a man haunted by a troubled past. But prejudice, family secrets, and long-standing rivalriesthreaten to tear them apart.

Amid deception, passion, and family conflict, Sofía and Franco will discover that finding happinessmay require risking everything.

name: Похищение
summary: MVD Captain Aglaia Mezentseva and investigator Vsevolod Kosinsky, one of the best specialists in child abduction cases, are unraveling the case of the missing 5-year-old grandson of world-renowned conductor Mark Kretchetov. The child mysteriously disappeared during a walk with his nanny, and the woman herself was hit on the head and lost her memory. Literally all members of the Kretchetov family fall under suspicion, and Kosinsky spares no one in his pursuit of results. Aglaia disapproves of Kosinsky's methods, but nevertheless becomes his best student. The more Aglaia untangles the web of complex family relationships and financial machinations within the Kretchetov family, the more she has to sacrifice – her peace of mind, her career, the lives and feelings of others. And even put her unborn child at risk.

name: The Princess's Snare
summary: Princess Royal Nangong Yao is determined to claim the highest seat of power. Standing in her way is Chu Yuan, the fiercely loyal general who serves faithfully at the Crown Prince's side. After countless confrontations, Nangong Yao comes to admire the depth of Chu Yuan's loyalty and becomes determined to win him over, making him acknowledge her as his true master. She sets her plans in motion, driving a wedge between him and his allies while carefully molding him to her side. This empire will be mine. And so will he.

name: Endless Summers
summary: Years after fate tore them apart, two former lovers unexpectedly cross paths again. As memories of the past collide with lingering feelings and undeniable chemistry, their reunion becomes a tantalizing push and pull of love and longing. Will they finally get the chance to rewrite their long-awaited summer romance?

name: Love You in the Dark
summary: Psychology PhD Lu Xizhou and rising artist Meng Lusha seem like the perfect couple. After a chance encounter on a rainy night, they build their dream life together in England. But the mysterious suicide of a young girl shatters their perfect world. As buried secrets, revenge, and long-held obsessions resurface, their seemingly flawless love begins to unravel.

name: Auspicious Nobles
summary: A modern financial prodigy, Li Qingqing, is suddenly transported back to ancient times, where she becomes the wife of General Pan Yang. Hoping for a quiet and peaceful life, she is blindsided three years later when her husband returns home with his mistress, Li Muyan. At the same time, a long hidden family secret comes to light, revealing that Li Muyan is the true daughter of the Li family. Faced with betrayal on every side, Li Qingqing remains calm. Secretly controlling the empire's most powerful intelligence and business network, Wangshi Tower, she deftly resolves the chaos within the household while matching wits with the ruthless Crown Prince. Armed with her modern financial expertise, she reshapes the ancient business world, overcoming one challenge after another with intelligence and wit. Through every scheme and upheaval, she carves out her own extraordinary path to power and redemption.

name: Di Er Shi Ba Nian Chun
Super Subbu
summary: When unlucky Subbu is assigned to teach sex ed in a hostile village, he must find a way to succeed while avoiding his conservative father's wrath.

name: Pokémon Horizons: The Series
summary: Pocket Monsters, or Pokémon for short. Mysterious creatures of this planet. They can be seen everywhere—in the sky, the sea, the forests, and even in the cities. Riko, a girl from Paldea who possesses a mysterious pendant. Roy, a boy from Kanto who possesses a mysterious Poké Ball. A new adventure for Riko and Roy begins in the vast world of Pocket Monsters ! What encounters and destinies await them!? This is a story of "discovering" something important through adventure.

previousepisode.name: Navi and the Child with the Mysterious Mask

name: Call Me if You Can
summary: The complex story of two people who get involved with a call centre gang and work together to break up a nation-wide scam organisation.

name: We Are Not Alone
summary:
Speaking to people from all different walks of life who have witnessed unidentified beings and unexplained phenomena first hand amid a surge in global fascination with extraterrestrial life. 

Each testimony adds to a bigger picture that asks if so many people are telling the same story, could it be true?

name: Dara's Dull Appreciation Society
summary: Guests from across the country will showcase their seemingly dull, but actually quite interesting, collections, pastimes and passions. Dara and his board must decide who cuts the mild mustard, who is thrilling by mistake, and who earns the ultimate accolade each episode: the Golden Fleece.

name: The Rules of Vacation
summary: The Rules of Vacation follows a newly unemployed woman who takes a summer vacation at her late grandmother's villa, only to cross paths with a mysterious caretaker.

name: Terror on Long Island
summary:
Terror on Long Island takes viewers deep into the chilling saga of a string of murders that haunted the Long Island area for over a decade.

Throughout the series, viewers will be guided through the intricate details of the investigation, with exclusive access to first-hand testimonies from those directly involved in the case. Retired detectives, FBI agents, and forensic experts will provide insight into the challenges they faced, the breakthroughs that led to Heuermann's arrest, and the lingering questions that remain. The series also includes emotional interviews with the families of the victims, who share their experiences of loss, frustration, and the painful journey toward closure.

name: Forever by Your Side
summary: Forever by Your Side follows 10 mature, single men and women (all over 50 years old) who leave their everyday lives to cohabitate and travel from Dali, China, to Thailand. The show challenges the stereotype that dating shows are only for the young, highlighting their brave, fearless pursuit of romance and companionship later in life.

name: Wushen Jue Dian
summary: Story of Wei Yuan, once the Qingxuan Emperor's son and the current Human Emperor, who reincarnates as a criminal slave of the Jiangnan Cui family. After awakening his past memories, he seeks revenge on the Cui family that framed him, in order to protect his younger sister Wei Yueyao. Along the way, he uncovers the truth of how he was betrayed by the gods in his previous life, and ultimately breaks through to the pinnacle of cultivation.

name: Aeronautica Imperialis
summary: Imperial Navy pilot Kae and her wingmen are tasked with securing a vital mining complex – a routine deployment that soon turns deadly. When sleek, unfamiliar fighters tear through the formation, survival pushes them to their absolute limits.

name: I Fell in Love Today
summary: High school students meet for a short-term romantic getaway, striving to make genuine connections and confessions of love within a limited three-day timeframe.

name: S.W.A.T. Exiles
summary: After a high-profile mission goes sideways, Daniel "Hondo" Harrelson is pulled out of forced retirement to lead a last-chance experimental S.W.A.T. unit made up of untested, unpredictable young recruits. Hondo must bridge a generational divide, navigate clashing personalities and turn a squad of outsiders into a team capable of protecting the city — and saving the program that made him who he is.

name: School Lawyer: Finding the Colors of the Stars
summary: School Lawyer: Finding the Colors of the Stars centers on Kenji Shiratori, a lawyer who perceives letters and sounds as specific colors and textures. Misunderstood in his youth, he found school to be a murky environment devoid of color. As an adult, he is appointed as the school lawyer at the newly merged, co-ed Hama Solaris Academy High School. He confronts modern youth crises—such as uniform backlash, truancy, and digital privacy—collaborating with school staff and the Astronomy Club to reach heartfelt resolutions.

name: Lock Upp
summary: Fifteen newsworthy celebrities must own their truth in the court of public opinion. Can they control the narrative, or will they be locked out?

name: Schalke - Dein Aufstieg
summary: Follow the emotional journey of a historic football club caught between the depths of crisis and the heights of hope. Beyond the action on the pitch, this Sky Original explores the cultural heartbeat of the Ruhr region, documenting why the people of Gelsenkirchen live, suffer, and never give up on their club.

name: Kings of Coke: The Legend of Rory Shayne
summary: Infamous for his spectacular bank heists, audacious prison breaks, and courtroom hostage standoffs, Rory Shayne tore through the underworld for decades—then vanished into thin air. Kings of Coke: The Legend of Rory Shayne takes audiences deep inside the legacy of a one‑of‑a‑kind criminal and the modern-day hunt of the underworld legend.

name: Overgeared
summary: Shin Youngwoo (a.k.a. Grid), an unlucky man in life and a low-level player in the popular VR game "Satisfy," finds a powerful item that earns him a rare legendary class title: "Pagma's Successor." He's now a skilled blacksmith who can forge unique weapons and equip the game's most powerful gear. Grid resolves to use his new abilities to achieve fame and fortune, but as his very existence begins to stir up trouble in Satisfy, he realizes that life as a legend may be more than he bargained for….

name: Αύριο
summary: An abandoned car is the only clue. Andreas and Marian entered the water before the flood and have been missing ever since. The Fire Department and the local Police are searching for them. The couple drifts into the canyon without knowing where the other is. Injured, they come out on the banks, screaming in vain, while their daughter searches for them. A wild night begins.

name: Young Americans
summary: In Young Americans, as the children of the nation's elite battle it out at Capitol Crest Academy in Washington D.C., their teenage dramas begin to mirror the larger political games of their parents. Amidst the secrets, scandals, and deadly ambitions, a forbidden romance between two students from opposing political families threatens to escalate tensions to a breaking point.

name: Хай Систерс
summary: The main characters of the series live in one of Moscow's residential areas. Despite their different personalities and views on life, the sisters support each other in all circumstances. Sveta is the eldest sister, an administrator at a supermarket. She is raising a son and dreams of a relationship, while struggling with trust issues towards men. Naive Dasha is the middle sister, who works as a kindergarten teacher and tries to be sensible. Kris is the youngest, a blogger. She runs a channel called "Hi, Sisters," dedicated to female support and self-identity. Despite their differences, the sisters remain close and united, helping each other – even if not always effectively.

name: Operation Dark Gold
summary: After failing to join the police force, police academy student Yan Mingyu is expelled for participating in underground boxing matches. Under the direction of Economic Crime Investigation Captain Chen Changjie, he is assigned an undercover mission within Tianyao Group, a powerful corporation run by his biological father, Mai Zhongwei. His objective is to investigate the notorious "812" money-laundering case while uncovering the truth behind his mother's death. Yan Mingyu soon learns that many of the hardships he endured were in fact carefully orchestrated tests designed to assess his suitability as an undercover operative. As he gradually earns the trust of Tianyao Group's leadership, he uncovers a sophisticated money-laundering network involving criminal syndicates that funnel illicit funds through high-profile auctions. His successful infiltration eventually allows him to rise through the ranks and take control of the company. On the eve of the final operation, a mole within law enforcement exposes Yan Mingyu's identity. In a desperate attempt to save his son, Mai Zhongwei sacrifices his life but is murdered by Zhang Junsheng. Framed as a criminal and placed on the wanted list, Yan Mingyu watches his teammates suffer devastating injuries. Forced into hiding, Yan Mingyu pretends to defect to the influential official Zhang Zhiyuan while secretly securing control of 1.5 billion yuan in criminal proceeds and the evidence linked to them through cryptocurrency transactions. In the end, through coordinated efforts from both inside and outside the criminal organization, the entire syndicate is brought to justice. Long-buried murder cases are finally solved, Yan Mingyu clears his name, and he ultimately returns to the police force.

name: My Stepmother and Stepsisters Aren't Wicked
summary: Miya is the illegitimate child of a prominent family. When her mother dies and her father's estate agrees to take her in, she's convinced she knows what awaits her in her new home: a life of servitude and misery at the hands of her wicked stepmother and stepsisters. Yet when she finally meets the women she expects to treat her like dirt, they actually end up being... sweet?! A hilarious and heartfelt comedy that's sure to put a smile on your face!

name: BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita
summary: BanG Dream! Yume∞Mita follows the virtual girl band Mugendai Mewtype (Yumemita) as five girls with unique, shining talents struggle to transition from isolated, individual performers into a cohesive musical group. The series explores their shared, fated journey that transcends virtual dreams and concrete reality, aiming for a global debut while dealing with the challenges of navigating, and ultimately surviving, both their digital and real-world struggles.

name: Draw This, Then Die!
summary: Ai Yasumi, a first-year high schooler living on the remote island of Izu Ōshima, has one obsession: manga. When she discovers that her long-idolized but reclusive favorite manga creator, Yasuno-sensei, will make a rare appearance at Comitia, Ai doesn't hesitate—she has to meet her hero. But that single decision sets off a chain of encounters that will shatter her assumptions about art, genius, and what it truly means to create.

previousepisode.name: Next World ~ Draw What You Love. Now and Forever...

name: Let's go KAIKIGUMI
summary: A nameless man who is six times more afraid of ghosts than the average person gets swept up with the supernatural. The trouble begins when he crosses paths with Mechako, a fearless girl who runs the Kaiki-gumi, an organization that polices the supernatural. Mechako ropes him into helping her revive the organization. Hilariously strange events and spooky shenanigans abound!

name: The Frontier Lord Begins with Zero Subjects
summary: The war is over, and hero Dias is finally rewarded with land of his own—only to discover it's a barren frontier with no people, no villages, and no sign of civilization. With nothing but endless grassland ahead of him, Dias sets out to build a domain from the ground up. But after meeting Alna, a mysterious girl with a blue horn, his lonely frontier is about to spring to life.

previousepisode.name: The Frontier Lord and the Story That Began with Zero Subjects

name: The Forsaken Saintess and Her Foodie Road Trip in Another World
summary: The story follows Rin Takanashi, a former caregiver in her thirties who is summoned to another world but immediately exiled. Using her "Motor House" skill, she summons a fully stocked modern camper van to cook and solo-camp her way across the fantasy realm.

previousepisode.name: Otsu-curry-sama! But the Adventure Continues, On and On!

name: Dodgeball Girl Danko
summary: Inheriting the fiery spirit of her legendary father, a passionate girl battles modern disinterest to build the strongest dodgeball team of the Reiwa era, facing off against the descendants of her father's old rivals in explosive, over-the-top matches.

previousepisode.name: The Fiery Showdown! The Final Battle!

name: Crowned in a Hundred Days
summary: After a tragedy destroys his life, a humble diner owner swallows the soul of the true king to gain extraordinary powers. With exactly one hundred days until his own soul is consumed, he embarks on a dangerous quest to defeat a tyrannical usurper, overthrow corrupt conglomerates, and help his host reclaim the throne.

name: Pompeii: A Day of Fire
summary: A series of overlapping stories of the people living in Pompeii and what their lives were like before fire rained down from the sky with the eruption of Mount Vesuvius.

name: Totally Spies!
summary: The live-action adaptation follows best friends Clover, Alex, and Sam as they balance saving the world as spies with the ups and downs of starting college, showcasing their girl power, friendship, and staying true to themselves.

name: The Everlasting
summary: Based on a historical fantasy novel, the series follows a scholar who travels back in time and becomes trapped in a time loop with a legendary knight, forcing them to challenge history and fate itself.

name: Iron Wok Jan!
summary: An arrogant, brilliant teenager arrives at a prestigious Chinese restaurant in Tokyo to fulfill his grandfather's dying wish. Operating under the brutal philosophy that "cooking is a battle," he engages in high-stakes culinary duels, clashing with rival chefs who believe food should be made with heart and care.

name: Recommendations from Iwamoto-Senpai
summary: The story follows Kodō Iwamoto, a third-year student at a military-controlled school. He is tasked with traveling across the countryside to investigate paranormal phenomena, track down people with uncanny supernatural abilities, and offer them letters of recommendation to join an elite, secretive military academy.

name: No tengo miedo
summary: When a 10-year-old boy stumbles upon a terrifying sight, he learns the brutal realities of life, survival and desperation in a town on the edge.

name: Salcedo, cuero y boogaloo
summary: Martín Salcedo is rarely swept off his feet — until Verónica Pinilla and Quiebra Canto turn up the party, booze and danger.

name: Разведчики
summary: A patriotic detective series about the challenging lives of spies in Russia, from the creators of *School 13 – Igroorgii*. Russian intelligence agents Ivan Smirnov, Sun-Dun Baldaev, and Roman Petskov save the world. Armed with natural resourcefulness and a ruthless knack for navigating conflict, they tackle impossible missions: overcoming the global crisis, ending famine in Africa, and resolving the Arab-Israeli conflict. Whether facing an anti-Russian Masonic order or a massive diamond-related catastrophe, the agents can defeat anything.

name: ЛИДА
summary: "LIDA" (Liminal Individual Diagnostic Algorithm) is a Russian AI technology designed to assist psychotherapists in addressing the deep layers of a patient's psyche, accurately identifying the root causes of traumatic conditions and facilitating healing. With the "LIDA" program, the path to recovery is intended to take just a few sessions, rather than years of therapy. The technology is currently in the final stage of clinical research, undergoing trials with volunteers and patients suffering from severe psychological conditions.

name: A Bona Fide Killer
summary: Ordinary working mom Yu Bo Na is secretly the legendary assassin Kingfisher, who eliminates criminals beyond the reach of the law. Returning to work after three years of maternity leave, she resumes a perilous double life, balancing work, childcare, housework, and assassinations. As her missions grow more dangerous, a detective hunting a mysterious killer and a husband beginning to suspect the truth threaten to expose her secret. From school drop-offs to taking down criminals, every moment is a high-wire act with no room to slip up. The instant her true identity surfaces, she stands to lose everything. Can Yu Bo Na keep her identity hidden and protect both worlds as a loving wife and mother to her family and a ruthless killer to her targets?

name: The Far Country
summary: Two people from different backgrounds escaping their own past and finding a new life in post World War 2 Australia, can their pasts be left behind? Can the war be forgotten?

name: Shit Show – Welcome to Reality
summary: With "Shit Show – Welcome to Reality", RTL+ deconstructs its own formula for success. This new eight-part mockumentary opens up the engine room of a (fictional) dating show—revealing that the real chaos reigns not among the pool of contestants, but behind the camera.

name: Wonka's The Golden Ticket
summary: In this one-of-a-kind reality competition, lucky players step inside Wonka's Chocolate Factory to face unpredictable games, tests and temptations.

name: Balaraw
summary: Years after her mother vanished, Sabina follows a mysterious clue to an uncharted island, where she confronts hidden dark secrets within her own family.

name: Street Restaurant Fighter
summary: Top chefs and restaurateurs from across Korea gather to launch new street food brands in a real-world business survival. From menu creation and pricing to service and turnover, every element of running a restaurant is tested. In a blind street battle where customers don't know the chefs, only sales decide the winner.

name: Szene Report
summary: Szene Report is a comedy series conceived as a mockumentary about subcultures of the past 30 years in Germany. Three episodes show insights into the microcosm of the emo scene, LAN parties and skate punk.

previousepisode.name: Beats, Bass and Bashes - Hip-Hop Capital Hamburg (1999) (Part 2)

name: Ten Little...Who?
summary: Join ten little characters on big adventures, counting from 10-1 as they go. Get ready for action, hilarious surprises, silly rhymes and so much fun! Inspired by the beloved Ten Little picture book series by Mike Brownlow and Simon Rickerty.

name: Duty First, Kiss Later
summary: A detective in his 40s gets along with everyone except his sharp-tongued younger colleague. But when a proposal to find the detective a match comes up, it ends up changing the relationship between the two.

name: Rob Rinder: The Crime I Can't Forget
summary: Rob Rinder returns to his roots as a criminal defence barrister to revisit one of the most haunting cases of his career. Twenty years on, Rinder revisits the case, reflecting on the events and examining his own role within them

name: Bone Parish
summary: In the dark underworld of New Orleans, the Winters family builds an empire around a powerful new drug—crafted from the ashes of the dead—that grants users vivid, haunting visions of the past. But as demand surges, rival factions, deadly secrets, and supernatural forces close in, pulling them deeper into a violent and inescapable nightmare of crime, horror, and family legacy.

name: Longing For You, Day and Night
summary: International violinist Shi Qi has spent four years emotionally freezing out her husband and neglecting their family because of a painful misunderstanding. Only when the truth begins to surface does she realize that the resentment she held onto may have been aimed at the wrong person all along.

name: Love Remains as Obsessive as Before
Ru: Taiwan Express
summary: Set in 1999, the story centers on Haruka Tada, a Tokyo office worker sent to Taiwan just as a Japanese consortium wins the contract for the high-speed rail. The project triggers memories of her first solo trip to Taiwan as a university student, where she briefly met a local man named Eric. The narrative unfolds across multiple intertwining lives over the course of several years, highlighting the deep cultural and personal bonds between Japan and Taiwan.

name: Tangled Up With Two Brothers
summary: To save her mother's company, Sang Ruan decides to marry Cheng Wang, the youngest son of the Cheng family. At the same time, she attracts Qin Yan, a top investor returning from overseas, to inject capital into the company to turn the tide. In her well-crafted first encounter, Qin falls in love at first sight, while Cheng also catches feelings for her. However, she is unaware that Qin and Cheng are biological brothers who each took one parent's surname; neither do the two know that they are after the same woman. Sang Xiaosu is the first to discover something amiss and actively exposes it, in hopes of destroying Sang Ruan. Realizing they are brothers, she acknowledges her mistake and expects to face the consequence, only for the brothers to turn against each other to win her heart. With three hearts entangled, which brother will she choose?

name: My Twisted Life Finds its Tender Love
Reverse Chase
summary: In 2011, detective Xu Weizhang discovers the skeleton of an unidentified woman concealed within the ruins of the Scala Nightclub, a victim whose death had remained hidden for sixteen years. During the investigation, he unexpectedly makes contact with police officer Liu Xinjian in 1995, forging a connection that transcends time. Working together across two different eras, the pair advance the investigation from opposite ends of the timeline, exchanging clues and piecing together the truth. Their unprecedented collaboration ultimately leads to the resolution of a serial murder case that had been buried for sixteen years.

name: Superbeast
summary: Superbeast is a series that showcases nature's ultimate athletes and apex predators as they survive and dominate in Earth's toughest arenas.

name: Let's Go Timmy!
summary: Bitzer the sheep dog is tasked with getting Timmy and his two best friends, Yabba and Apricot, to Mossy Bottom School safe and on time each morning! Like all excitable children Timmy and the gang are curious, full of energy, and every morning turns into a surrealist escapade as they veer off-course turning the school run into an adventure. Thankfully Bitzer, the long-suffering and faithful chaperone always manages to get to them to the school gates in the nick of time.

name: The Chase Around the World
summary: The Chase Around the World will take contestants on a global adventure competition. This series sees six pairs of contestants attempt to track down the biggest brains in Britain - all six of The Chasers - in undisclosed locations around the globe. Unravelling puzzles along the way, the winning pair will pit their knowledge against The Chasers in order to win a life-changing prize pot.

name: The Surf House
summary: The Surf House is set high on the cliffs of Morocco and is based in a sanctuary for surfers and travellers chasing sunshine and waves. But the idyll hides a dark mystery, and when Bea washes in, seeking refuge after a dangerous encounter in Marrakesh, she soon gets caught in the current. A woman her age – who stayed in the same area, walked the same beaches, met the same guests – disappeared one year earlier, vanishing without trace, and her last known whereabouts was The Surf House.

name: Toon World Express
summary: A late-night indie animated comedy showcase aboard a cartoon train to Toon World, with deranged shorts from cult-favorite creators.

name: GIGN
summary: After an unprecedented attack on his elite unit, a high-ranking officer set to leave the field leads a perilous mission that forces him to confront his past.

name: Wayward Kenting
summary:
Web novelist Xiaowei builds her career writing powerful romances. But in real life, she often ends up being the one getting cheated on. The pressure becomes too much that she decides to go on an exile to Kenting in Southern Taiwan. 

Xiaowei befriends three Kenting locals - Hanwen, Liangliang and Azuo. She also becomes friends with Anan, a young man who also travels southward to Kenting. The five of them experience struggles, love, losses, pain, self-discoveries and much more. 

The story also tells of a prominent financial holding company that arbitrarily modifies the development proposal put forth by Chu Yiyang, and goes on land grabbing through Zhong Hanwen, incurring the wrath of the locals.

name: Pritam and Pedro
summary: The dynamic between the two contrasting personalities, a seasoned cop who prefers old-school methods and a tech-savvy cop who relies on modern technology for investigations, as they navigate their partnership in solving crimes.

name: Sarek
summary: Two survivors. Two conflicting stories. Only one can be true. When a badly wounded woman is airlifted to safety, she tells police a terrifying story: their group of friends fell under the psychopathic control of a charismatic outsider, leading to manipulation and psychological torture, and death. But just as the case appears closed, an unpredictable twist shatters everything — one of the supposed victims is still alive, and her account of what happened in the wilderness is utterly different.

name: Bad Boyfriends
summary: Eight men believe they are participating in a reality TV show, while their partners secretly test their loyalty and relationship skills. Love, comedy, and drama collide in a luxury villa and the "Bro Zone."

name: Niko Tama
summary: The series focuses on Asao Atsuko, who works at a bento shop, and her partner, patent attorney Iwaki Kohei. Despite being university sweethearts who have comfortably lived together for 12 years, their routine is disrupted when Kohei has a one-time affair with his colleague Yuko. This explores their struggles with emotional drifting, hesitation, and the nature of "family".

name: Eleceed
summary: High school student Jiwoo Seo knows nothing of the hidden world around him. Terrified of his own mysterious powers, he lives quietly, concealing his abilities from everyone. But everything changes the day he rescues a battered stray cat who turns out to be none other than Kayden—the most powerful Awakened being alive.

name: Open House Chicago
summary: An Exclusive, insiders look at the hottest residential properties in the Chicagoland market.

name: Songs of U.S.
summary: Salt Lick Session presents: "Songs of U.S.", a new performance and conversation series bringing together artists from across the American musical landscape to reinterpret songs that have shaped the country's cultural identity — and to ask what belongs in the American songbook today.

name: 404: The Camellia Will Bloom
summary: Zhao Yanqing, the heir to a wealthy family, falls in love at first sight with Jiang Li, the daughter of his family's driver, after she drives him home one evening. He's helping her family discreetly. She's a fighter who won't accept help easily. Between them: an eight year age gap, social gap - the daughter of the help? It's a huge class difference Aware of the gulf between their social standing, Jiang Li hesitates. For years. Fate brings them together once more at the 404 Pub.

name: Deep Revenge
summary: After waking from a four-year coma and learning that her ex-husband had plotted her murder, Nozomi takes on a new identity and seeks revenge.

name: Where Colors Dream
summary: Set against the backdrop of Republican-era Shanghai, Xu Yanzhen, an orphaned painter with extraordinary artistic talent, unexpectedly crosses paths with Jiang Xinyu, the chief accountant of Ronghui Bank, who has been framed and pushed into a desperate situation. Forced into an uneasy alliance, the two soon uncover a scheme to sell a priceless national treasure painting to foreign buyers at a bargain price. Using her remarkable forgery skills, Xu Yanzhen creates a flawless replica, allowing them to secretly swap the original masterpiece. As powerful forces close in from every side, Xu Yanzhen and Jiang Xinyu navigate a web of deception and danger with courage and ingenuity. Together, they overcome one peril after another, unravel hidden conspiracies, and fight to protect their country's cultural heritage.

name: Muthassi
summary: A mother, torn between love and destruction, faces her son's demonic change from a cursed lineage.

name: Jumelles
summary: Emma and Florence, 14-year-old twins, one with black skin and the other white, must redefine their identity after the tragic death of a young black woman in their neighborhood.

name: The Dark Side of the Sun
summary: In a psychiatric hospital overseas in Country M, the most dangerous patient, Xiao Mu Chen, passes his 144th mental evaluation and is finally discharged. But no one knows that his condition has never truly improved-he still sees the phantom of his fiancée, Jin Zhao Xi, whispering in his ear, urging him to take bloody revenge. Four years ago, on the day he had planned to propose, Jin Zhao Xi was brutally murdered. He arrived too late, only to see the four culprits walking away, laughing. Now, at last free, he begins the revenge he has long prepared for...

name: Strange — Junji Ito's Strange Stories for Sleepless Nights
summary: Live-action anthology TV drama series adapting stories from Junji Ito's "Masterpiece Collection."

name: GBRB: Farm Operation - Go Go Farm
summary: They're back, but this time, at a farm! The three men's chaotic journey to adjust to animal farm life begins! The Lee Kwang-soo, Kim Woo-bin, Doh Kyung-soo trio arrives In the peaceful farm that sits on the lush, green pastures of Jeju. This time, they're kicking off a brand-new life alongside dozens of cows. From feeding the cows at the crack of dawn, checking on the fences, and handling all sorts of tasks popping up endlessly, they are suddenly hit with an unexpected crisis. Will the trio manage to keep the peace and survive the farm? A farm-tastic farmstay of the three besties, where laughter, friendship, and the beautiful nature of Jeju all mix and mingle.

previousepisode.name: La chute de la maison Usher

name: The Night Mist Scorches
summary: From the age of five, Lu Ying clung to Jin Bei Zhou like a shadow, even until they married. Jin Bei Zhou would rather believe the world turned upside down than for Lu Ying to leave him. But a sudden kidnapping made Lu Ying realize that no one can live without the other. In their third year of marriage, Lu Ying filed for divorce. But Jin Bei Zhou refused to let go,crushing his pride and begging her with bloodshot eyes not to leave. It turned out that the person they couldn't live without was Jin Bei Zhou.

name: Hey Kay Navin?
summary: Rama and Umesh are a happy couple with a good home, a loving family and well-settled corporate jobs. They've passed all the big hurdles of a relationship - romantic 20s, long marriage, setting up a home and finally.

name: Sui Sui Huai An
summary: Song Huai Chuan, a member of the Nuwa clan, is tricked into forming a contract with Xu Sui An, who suffers from a terminal illness. He initially intends to use marriage as a cover to stabilize his company and uncover the truth behind his mother's death; Xu Sui An, in turn, can be cured of her illness using the bloodline of the Nuwa clan. Both get what they want, but in theprocess of investigating the truth, Song Huai Chuan discovers that Xu Sui An seems to have a complex relationship with his mother, and that she is not a simple human girl, but a shrouded-in-mystery figure.

name: A Filha
summary: The new series is a Maria & Mayer production, with project direction by António Borges Correia and support from ICA. The story features a cast composed of big names in Portuguese fiction, such as Dalila Carmo, Diogo Infante, Inês Castel-Branco, José Condessa, Sara Barradas, and São José Lapa.

name: Newlywed Addiction
summary: Qiao Yuan is forced into marriage with Fu Tingzhou after her older sister runs away from the wedding. To the outside world, this looks like a sudden replacement marriage, but for Qiao Yuan it is much more dangerous emotionally — because Fu Tingzhou is the man she has secretly loved for ten years. After marriage, she becomes his most familiar stranger at home and his most reliable partner at work. Their relationship starts with obligation, distance, and old feelings hidden under professionalism, but the longer they stay beside each other, the harder it becomes to pretend this marriage is only an arrangement.

name: Пригоди козака Виговського
summary: Facing execution, a compromised capital-city spy named Ivan Vyhovsky is forced to accept a seemingly doomed assignment. Instead of the gallows, a perilous mission awaits him—one that transforms the former agent into a fearless Cossack leader.

name: My Lady's Bodyguard
summary: Disguise might be able to hide the truth, but it can never hide the feelings born within the heart. When a female bodyguard must protect a mischievous young lady who is the light of her life - how will this love story end?

name: Sisters' Heist
summary: Adapted from "Sister's Heist" in Yan Yan Story. Xia Yan and Fang Yun, two best friends, accidentally transmigrate into a novel. Xia Yan becomes the obsessed wife of the cunning second male lead, Gu Bochuan, while Fang Yun is forced into the role of stand-in lover for the dangerous yandere antagonist, Gu Wang. On the surface, they play their parts as lovelorn captives, but behind closed doors, they are secretly indulging in every luxury their lavish, high-society lives afford. When the "white moonlight" female lead, Shen Mianmian, returns, the two decide to "fake their deaths" and escape to avoid being swept into the tragic plot of the original story…

name: Did You Know
summary:
The story follows a dedicated surgeon and a successful hotel entrepreneur who have known each other since their school days.

Their relationship has always existed somewhere between attraction and rivalry. Everything changed after one particular night, leaving unanswered questions that one of them desperately tries to forget while the other refuses to let go.

Now, fate continues bringing them together. Between hospital corridors and luxury hotel halls, both women struggle to navigate unresolved emotions, professional responsibilities, and feelings they have carried for years.

name: Addicted To Marriage
summary: Addicted To Marriage is centered around an arranged or contract-style marriage deal, and explores how the protagonists transition from a strict agreement to developing genuine affection.

name: Quiet in the Office!
summary: Nayul was at her breaking point. Between the crushing workload and her detestable boss, Kwon Sijin-a man who perfected the art of trampling on dignity-she'd had enough. At 11 PM on a Friday, driven by pure rage, she stormed into his office. There, time froze. Nayul stood paralyzed, having caught her "perfect" yet perverted boss in the middle of a private, lewd act during overtime.

name: Hide One's Love
summary: In this game of love, Nan Ye Jue is the conqueror, the brutal plunderer. He gives Rong En ten days to compromise, then gradually closes in, completely destroying Rong En's once-normal life. The superior bows to love, but Rong En always remembers the pain he inflicted. Her unwavering clarity drives Nan Ye Jue ever more mad, and he's determined to keep her by his side at all costs.

name: Mermaid Husband
summary: Amidst the mermaid civil war, the Empress Princess Yun Ling —the heir with a sacred mission—stripped of her powers and exiled her to the mortal realm. Four merfolk closely tied to Yun Ling transformed into a doctor, a celebrity, a CEO, and a mafia boss to infiltrate the human world. Their quest: Find Yun Ling, uncover why she vanished... and confront her mortal incarnation, Xia Shi Yue, in a story of fire and tides.

name: The Captive Rose
summary: After catching her fiancé cheating with her stepsister and being thrown out by her own father, Wen Qiansu's life falls apart. On a rainy night, she meets the mysterious Mr. Huo, a man rumored to be cold and unhinged—but who treats her with unexpected kindness. As their relationship grows, Qiansu remains unaware that Mr. Huo has loved her for years and has been given a second chance at life, hiding the dark obsession that once led him to imprison her as he tries to protect her and rewrite their fate.

name: Forever Love
summary: Meng Yu was fostered away from home from a young age. Her biological parents doted on their adopted daughter, Meng Huan, and only used her. After breaking up with her ex-boyfriend, she was forced to accept her family's arrangement to marry Fu Qingshao, the heir to the Fu Group. He needed a loveless, unconditional wife to avoid suspicion, while she needed the status of Mrs. Fu to live a stable life and earn money to treat her adoptive mother's illness. The two, each getting what they wanted, signed a contract and hastily got married.

name: Tonight, I Have a Date with a Serial Killer
summary: When Isogai realizes that Hinata has the ability to spot murderers, he asks her to help him find the serial killer who murdered his fiancée, Azusa Kawada.

name: Burning Beauty
summary: Jiang Jiao was sold by the Jiang family into a marriage alliance with Fu Ran. At their first meeting, Fu Ran tried to force her into a divorce and even resorted to violence. Though she appeared gentle and obedient, Jiang Jiao was in fact ruthless, pretending to be compliant while secretly plotting revenge against both the Jiang family and the Lu family, stirring up storms in the business world.

name: Fen Shou Hou, Cheng Yi Sheng Ku Chu Bi Ti Pao
summary: Luo Jia discovers that Cheng Jin, the new transfer from orthopedics, is the very man she had a one-night stand with the night before. Cheng Jin switches seamlessly between domineering and puppy-like, successfully winning Luo Jia's heart. Just as their romance grows sweet, Luo Jia learns that Cheng Jin only approached her to get revenge on his ex-girlfriend. Heartbroken, she returns to Yu City. Unexpectedly, Cheng Jin follows her there, beginning his desperate "wife-chasing crematorium" journey.

name: Die Realitystar Academy
summary: Die Realitystar Academy, the reality competition centers on a ruthless talent factory where 18 undiscovered hopefuls cram for fame. Guided by prominent reality figures, the candidates must survive grueling tasks and daily drama to prove they have what it takes to be the next big reality TV main character.

name: Idaten Jump
summary: Idaten Jump follows a young, passionate mountain biker named Sho Yamato who is mysteriously transported to the "X-Zone" alongside his friends and his custom bike, the Flame Kaiser. To return to their home world, the group must win high-stakes "Idaten Battles" against other riders across various treacherous environments.

previousepisode.name: A New Journey, Restoring the World!

name: Crossroad
summary: Crossroad follows a clash of personalities and ideals within the high-pressure environment of Yokohama Bay Hospital.

name: Here U Are
summary: Yang Yu is a university upperclassman who's loved by everyone, and Huan Li is a quiet, antisocial new student. The two of them get off on the wrong foot, but despite clashing and repelling one another at times, they are still drawn to each other.

name: The Guy She Was Interested in Wasn't a Guy at All
summary: Fashionable and upbeat high schooler Aya loves listening to rock, but no one else seems to share her interest…until she meets a cool, stylish employee at a CD shop. Dressed in black from head to toe, he has this air of mystery about him, and his taste in music is impeccable. Aya falls hard for him—not knowing her crush is actually her female classmate Mitsuki! For her part, Mitsuki generally keeps to herself and avoids standing out at school. But given that she sits right next to Aya, Mitsuki's all too aware of the other girl's feelings, and she's afraid to reveal the truth. So why does she find herself talking with Aya more and more…?

name: First Love Returns
summary: After serving a stint in prison, single mom Gu Xing Wan is released and struggles to find a job in the law field. She ends up as the legal assistant to her ex-boyfriend, Attorney Yan, who can't understand why she wouldn't let him wait for her 5 years ago.

name: Professor Zhou Was the First to Fall in Love
summary: In her previous life, Jiang Song Chu died in an earthquake. The husband she had never truly cared about, Zhou Qi An, instead chose to quietly watch over her until the end. Given a second chance at life, Jiang Song Chu returns to four years earlier, to the time when she and Zhou Qi An had been married for just one year through a whirlwind marriage. This time, she decisively cuts ties with the charming but shallow Lin Tian and reunites with Zhou Qi An. Jiang Song Chu soon confirms that Zhou Qi An has not been reborn like she has. Armed with the experiences of her previous life, she quickly realizes that beneath Zhou Qi An's serious and proper exterior as a university professor lies feelings for her that he has harbored for a long time. However, his overly restrained and principled nature was precisely why she noticed nothing in her last life. Determined not to repeat her regrets, Jiang Song Chu makes up her mind: in this life, she will take the initiative, draw closer to Zhou Qi An, and win his heart.

name: Nian Nian Ru Huai
summary: After successfully confessing her love, 18-year-old girl Xu Chu Nian traveled through time and space to become a 24-year-old abandoned wife of a wealthy family. Faced with her indifferent husband, Jiang Huai Xu, and her mute daughter, Zhu Zhu, she was determined to save everything. When strange memories and men in black appeared frequently, she discovered that the world was actually set in a novel! Xu Nian Chu broke free from control and fought against the plot. She could only write her own life!

name: Double Blade
summary: Three years ago, to save her critically ill grandmother, Gu Xingwan unilaterally blocked her boyfriend Ji Yan, who was studying abroad, and got together with Fu Sihan. Three years later, when she accompanied Fu Sihan to visit his parents, she unexpectedly encountered Ji Yan, who had been searching for her for three years. Ji Yan couldn't accept reality and began to relentlessly pursue Gu Xingwan. At the same time, Fu Sihan's favoritism completely broke Gu Xingwan's heart, and she resolutely broke up with Fu Sihan, bringing a new turning point to their relationship.

name: Turquoise Summer
summary: Follow three lifelong friends as they leave their pasts behind for the sun-drenched shores of Bodrum—a place of escape, reckoning, and unexpected rebirth.

name: Dia a Dia com Goldenboy
summary: Dia a Dia com Goldenboy, hosted by streamer and presenter Felipe Goldenboy, serves up behind-the-scenes moments and pop culture commentary directly from the network's studios.

previousepisode.name: A VERDADE da COPA na DiaTV: Beta Boechat, Diva Depressão e Cá Fremder desabafam

name: WM 1994 – Elf Helden, ein Albtraum
summary: For the 1994 World Cup, Germany entered as the favorite and defending champion, but was eliminated in the quarterfinals. Internal conflicts, media campaigns, and public criticism of coach Berti Vogts led the so-called "eleven friends" – players like Lothar Matthäus, Jürgen Klinsmann, Stefan Effenberg, Bodo Illgner, and Matthias Sammer – to maneuver themselves into a collective nightmare within just a few weeks. This documentary takes a behind-the-scenes look at Germany's memorable World Cup and shows how one of the strongest German teams of all time spectacularly failed.

name: Low Tide in Twilight
summary: Burdened by crushing debt, omega Kim Euihyun struggles to protect his younger brother while searching for a way out of despair. His life changes after meeting the wealthy alpha Yeo Taeju, leading to a complicated relationship shaped by survival, trust, and love.

name: BaseBoys
summary: Four boys enter a music contest, hoping to win money for gaming equipment. But they are surprised when they do so well that they become a popular boy band.

name: Два с половиной повара
summary: Kristina and Albina have a lot of secrets and tricks that turn things in the kitchen into a fun holiday. Together with them, viewers will learn how to create a real branch of a restaurant at home, where not only delicious, but also very beautiful food is served.

name: Romantic Island
summary: Ye Ji enters a 19+ dating show with a huge cash prize for her boyfriend, who lost everything. The only way to win the 1.9 billion prize is to spend the night with another man. There, she meets Jae Hyeon, her first love, and Do Hyeok, the ex-husband she broke up with after an affair. Between true love, the 1.9 billion prize, and her own desires—what will Ye Ji choose?

name: The Dean Martin Celebrity Roast
summary: For a series of 54 specials and shows, Martin would periodically "roast" a celebrity. These roasts were patterned after the roasts held at the New York Friars' Club in New York City. The format would have the celebrity guest seated at a banquet table, and one by one the guest of honor was affectionately chided or insulted about his career by his fellow celebrity friends.

name: Yankı Görünmez El
summary: Eray, a senior manager in a bank, does not get the promotion he looks up to. As his moral compass is put to test, he finds himself having to choose between integrity and ambition: Will he get the position he deserves by any means necessary?

name: Dynasty of the Undead: Mutate
summary: Set in a fictional ancient empire, the dark sorcery of the Mijiang people creates an undead monster army that invades the Dasheng realm, leading to the capital's fall and the emperor's capture. Fang Sun, a Mijiang orphan with eagle-like vision, and Princess Xiao Qing of Dasheng form an alliance. Trapped in a besieged city amid political intrigue and hordes of monsters, they lead soldiers and civilians in a desperate last stand with cold weapons and muskets, fighting both the undead horde and traitors to save their nation. Blending Eastern political intrigue, doomsday survival, and superhuman awakening, it features dark, intense visuals and a fast-paced plot.

name: Naked and Afraid: Shipwrecked
summary:
Under the impression that they are entering a standard 35-day group challenge at dawn, the survivalists instead begin their insertion adrift at sea overnight. With emergency flares shooting overhead, the survivalists must grab whatever limited resources they can before making their way ashore. 

Divided into four groups of three, the survivalists are stranded on a mysterious and isolated island on the lost coast of the Philippines, often described as the "Bermuda Triangle of Southeast Asia," due to its history of past shipwrecks and unexplained disappearances. The terrain offers both opportunities and risk, with a dense, resource-rich jungle that contains the remnants of those who came before. Teams work together to build shelters and tools from the wreckage, including a 300-foot primitive water aqueduct. In the surrounding seas, survivalists must contend with tiger and hammerhead sharks, stingrays, sea snakes and box jellyfish whose venom contains one of the ocean's most lethal toxins. 

Far removed from civilization and with no food, no fresh water and no clothing, the survivalists must adapt quickly, relying not only on their individual skills but also on their ability to innovate and salvage whatever they can from the environment. With each team receiving only one piece of the challenge map, they must track down the others and combine pieces to rescue themselves from the island on Day 35.

name: Harlan Coben's Myron Bolitar
summary: After an injury ends his NBA dreams, Myron Bolitar reinvents himself as a sports agent - using charm, smarts, and a ruthless partner to navigate the high-stakes and dirty world of sports, where saving his clients often means risking himself.

name: Young Swordsman
summary: Born with sealed meridians and death written into his fate, Peng Dasheng was never meant to become a hero. Sent down the mountain to break off his engagement, the powerless disciple of the Wuhuduandao Sect discovers a destiny beyond imagination. With one miracle after another, he defeats six Demon Sect masters and rises to become the leader of the martial alliance. When his true identity is revealed, the hero once revered by all is cast out by the entire martial world. Only then does the soul jade awaken, unlocking the power hidden within him. Now, Peng Dasheng will defy the fate that cursed him, destroy the Demon Sect's hidden mastermind, and reshape the entire martial world before disappearing into legend with the woman he loves.

name: How Do We Relationship?
summary: Shy Miwa has always dreamed of finding love, but living in small-town Japan made finding the right match difficult—especially since she likes girls! Even going away to college didn't seem to help, until one day her outgoing classmate Saeko suggests they might as well start dating each other since it's not like either of them has other options. At first it seems like things won't work out as their personalities clash and misunderstandings abound. But when their casual friendship starts to become something more, Miwa begins to wonder—can a pragmatic proposal lead to true love?

name: Guilty Creatures
summary: Guilty Creatures delves into the psyche of a torrid romance and subsequent act of murder between two young, adulterous but God-fearing lovers, unraveling their complex lives and the emotional toll of living as killers for 18 years.

name: Exposed: The Ghost Train Fire
summary: This three-part documentary series explores the mysterious details surrounding the Sydney Luna Park tragedy that took seven lives in 1979.

name: Who Wants To Marry My Dad?
summary: The adult children of a single father choose among several suitors to decide which woman will marry their dad.

name: A Killer in the Family: The Murder of Becky Watts
summary: A teenage girl goes missing from her home in Bristol, prompting a huge search across the city and a social media campaign to find her. As days pass fears grow that she may have come to harm. As the police investigation progresses shocking evidence is discovered, pointing towards a family member for her murder but no one could have imagined what happened next.

name: El problema final
summary: In the spring of 1959, thirteen people were stuck by a violent storm on a small islet near Mallorca. Any of them could anticipate what is about to happen at the small hotel where they're staying: Elisa Mander, a discreet British tourist, is found dead. What initially seems like a suicide soon raises unsettling signs—it may in fact be murder. Basil, a retired actor once famous for portraying none other than Sherlock Holmes on the big screen, finds himself unexpectedly tasked with unravelling the case. In a place no one can leave—and no one can reach—every guest and staff member becomes a suspect in a crime that grows more intricate and twisted by the minute.

name: Fred Has Problems
summary: Follows Fred, an optimistic everyman trying to do the right thing who somehow creates absolute chaos for himself.

previousepisode.name: Fred Nailed My Wife in the Pumpkin Patch

name: Stand Up to Cancer
summary: Live broadcast television event. Some of the biggest names in entertainment are on hand to raise money for the fight against cancer.

name: Macha Dynasty: Zhong Kui
summary: Lin Xiaojia, a young amusement park mechanic, accidentally travels to a parallel universe: the Zhaoming Dynasty, an industrial superpower ruled by Mohist mechanical engineering. When Japanese onmyoji send mutated beasts to invade, the centuries-old giant Mohist mecha "Zhong Kui" is awakened by Lin. Using modern repair skills to pilot the ancient mecha, he joins the Mech Bureau to fight interdimensional beasts and conspiracies, igniting a thrilling clash between Eastern ancient machinery and modern mecha combat across time and space.

name: Please Don't Break Anything
summary: Four months after a night gone horribly wrong, Billie holds a gathering in honour of her dead best friend. But as the night unfolds, she realises her mates may be hiding more than they seem.

name: Voyagers: Exploring Pacific Waters
summary: Over 3,500 years, brave voyagers cross millions of miles of harsh Pacific Ocean in handmade canoes. They find and settle thousands of islands, reaching as far as Guam, Hawaii, Rapa Nui and Fiji. Becoming master navigators, they overcome deadly natural barriers, and build an ocean world like no other - one connected by canoes and legends of the sea.

name: Adam Liaw's North American Fan Feasts
summary: Adam Liaw embarks on an extraordinary culinary journey across North America, celebrating how food, sport, and culture unite communities and shape national identity.

name: L.O.L. Surprise! The Next Headliner
summary: Five aspiring performers compete for a coveted music industry opportunity, only to discover that their greatest strength lies in collaboration rather than rivalry. As they navigate friendship, self-doubt and the pressures of pursuing a music career, they form a band and chart their own path to stardom.

name: Celebrity Tipping Point NZ
summary: Daniel Faitaua takes the tried-and-true Tipping Point formula and infuses it with a distinctly Kiwi flavour, alongside some some of Aotearoa's favourite famous faces

name: Summer Unboxed with Maisie and Joel
summary: Maisie and Joel experience the unpredictability of a British summer through a series of light-hearted challenges. Mystery boxes filled with quirky postcards, seasonal items, and essentials from Boots guide them through each task. Their journey takes them from festivals to seaside trips and countryside wellness retreats, where they tackle activities like capturing the perfect beach photo and cycling a tandem route. Throughout, they stay prepared for changing conditions with a range of health and beauty products suited to every setting.

name: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab
summary: Put a Ring on It: Cheathab follows long-term couples whose relationships have been rocked by infidelity as they move into the Miami-based "Cheathab House" to confront the trust issues, jealousy, and unresolved wounds threatening their futures. An emotionally charged journey of accountability, difficult choices and redemption.

name: Saved by the Ice Cold Prince's Embrace
summary: As the illegitimate daughter of a count and his maid, Katrina was born into miserable circumstances. And now that she's lost her mother, the treatment from her stepsister and stepmother the countess has only grown worse. One day, her stepsister receives a royal order to move to the northern outskirts due to her unseemly behavior at a recent party. There, she is to learn proper conduct under the tutelage of the resident prince, rumored to be a cruel man. Not wanting to subject her daughter to such punishment, the countess decides to send Katrina instead. Katrina arrives in the north shaking in fear. But contrary to the stories, the "merciless and cold-hearted" prince is kinder than she believed. Might the pure-hearted Katrina find love in the wintry countryside?

name: Bulges
summary: Bulges follows the lovably eccentric staff at an iconic and once-thriving all-male, not-so-family friendly restaurant called Bulges in Niagara Falls, Ontario, as they embrace friendship, juggle complicated love lives, and fend off ruthless cross-town rivals... all while sporting booty shorts that are tight in all the right places.

name: The Great American Road Rally: Celebrity Edition
summary: The series takes audiences on a high-energy journey across America's most iconic highway, combining adventure, competition, entertainment, community celebration, and philanthropy.

name: Пять причин поехать в…
summary: "Five Reasons to Visit..." is a television program that introduces the unique nature, sights, culture, and traditions of the peoples of the Commonwealth countries. Traveling with us is always exciting, because we always have "five reasons" to do so.

previousepisode.name: Молодая столица. Какими достопримечательностями встречает Астана?

name: Baddies
summary: After a botched bank heist and a stolen cop car collide, four misfit kids sent to a dodgy youth camp find themselves standing between a crew of robbers and a million bucks.
